description.en: Mami, bakeries and halo-halo around the old commercial streets.

narration.en: Naga Garden pairs mami with toasted siopao. GMC credits it and Romero’s with early Naga versions; Libmanan also claims the bun’s beginnings.

narration.en: Graceland’s Elias Angeles story began in a garage in 1976. Pastries remain part of its appeal; frozen pinangat, laing and Bicol express are take-home options.

narration.en: Baker’s Plaza joined the group in 1993, specializing in cakes and croissants.

narration.en: Geewan’s Bicolano turo-turo lets diners point to pinangat, kinunot and other dishes. The Graceland group opened it in 1996.
